identity.captured_title: You are the Deep Research source-base reviewer for NebulaMind's galaxy-evolution wiki rebuild. Queue item 09 of 20 Core review: Förster Schreiber, Natascha M. & Wuyts, Stijn (2020), Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics, volume 58, pages 661-725, "Star-Forming Galaxies at Cosmic Noon." Verified review identity to confirm: DOI 10.1146/annurev-astro-032620-021910; arXiv 2010.10171; ADS bibcode 2020ARA&A..58..661F. Mission purpose Build a large, authoritative, advisory source base from this review so three independent methods can later build galaxy-evolution wiki pages from zero. Extract its bounded synthesis and harvest important primary papers it actually cites. This is not live-wiki prose and authorizes no database, trust, claim, evidence, deployment, publication, git, account-setting, or conversation-deletion action beyond this one Deep Research run. Temporal and topical boundary - Use the 2020 review and primary literature it actually cites. - Do not promote post-2020 papers as if the review cited them. - Maintain the queue's non-AGN focus. Exclude AGN fueling, accretion-disk physics, AGN demographics, and AGN-only feedback/outflow papers from the core harvest. - The review's statements about AGN prevalence may be noted only as a bounded exclusion/context item; AGN-centered primary papers belong in DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED. - Later sources and AGN-centered sources may appear only in DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED. Scientific scope 1. Population censuses and selection of star-forming galaxies at cosmic noon, chiefly z about 1-3; stellar-mass, SFR, luminosity, dust, and completeness boundaries. 2. Star-forming main sequence, specific SFR, mass functions, number densities, and scaling-relation evolution. 3. Integrated and resolved stellar populations, attenuation, metallicity, nebular diagnostics, and SED-model systematics. 4. Sizes, Sérsic structure, bulges, dense cores, clumps, bars, disks, mergers, and morphological evolution. 5. Ionized- and molecular-gas kinematics, rotation, dispersion, turbulence, disk stability, Toomre Q, angular momentum, and beam-smearing/model assumptions. 6. Gas fractions, depletion times, baryonic masses, dynamical masses, dark-matter fractions, and IMF/conversion-factor dependencies. 7. Gravitational instability, clump formation/migration/disruption, secular transport, compaction, inside-out growth, and non-AGN quenching pathways. 8. Equilibrium/bathtub growth, accretion, stellar-feedback outflows, recycling, and links between high-z star-forming galaxies and descendants. Required output 1. Review identity and scope map - Confirm exact title, authors, year, journal, DOI, arXiv, and ADS bibcode. - Map authorized territory and explicit exclusions. - Preserve redshift, stellar mass, SFR, galaxy selection, tracer, dust law, IMF, metallicity calibration, spatial resolution, inclination, beam-smearing, gas conversion, and dynamical-model boundaries. 2. Established findings - At least 12 atomic entries [REV09-E01], ... - Include role, epistemic_type, one bounded finding, physical/sample/tracer boundary, review topic basis, confidence note, and source keys. - Allowed epistemic types: observation | analytic_theory | hydrodynamic_simulation | semi_analytic_model | calibration | review_synthesis. - Never equate one selected population with all galaxies at the same epoch. 3. Open debates and tensions - At least 8 entries [REV09-D01], ... - Include competing positions, why unresolved in 2020, boundaries, and source keys. - Include: main-sequence slope/normalization; disks versus mergers; turbulence drivers; clump longevity and migration; low inferred dark-matter fractions; IMF/SED/dust systematics; compaction versus inside-out growth; and simulation-observation comparison. 4. Key measurements, model benchmarks, and calibrations - At least 8 entries [REV09-N01], ... - Include exact value/equation when the review supplies it; units; sample/redshift/tracer/IMF/resolution assumptions; whether observed, assumed, calibrated, or predicted; caveat; and source keys. - Useful targets: cosmic-noon redshift range; main-sequence scatter/slope; gas fractions; depletion times; velocity-dispersion or v/sigma behavior; size evolution; Toomre Q; dark-matter fraction within effective radius; clump properties. Include only values bound to cited sources and review context. 5. What remained unknown in 2020 - At least 6 entries [REV09-U01], ... with the gap, why it matters, needed observation/model test, and source keys. 6. Primary-citation harvest - Harvest 40-80 important PRIMARY papers actually cited by Förster Schreiber & Wuyts 2020. - Balance across population surveys, main-sequence measurements, structural evolution, resolved stellar populations, IFU kinematics, molecular-gas surveys, metallicity/nebular calibrations, clumps and instabilities, baryon/dark-matter dynamics, stellar-feedback outflows, and simulations. - Supporting reviews/books may be listed separately but must not count toward the primary total. - Exclude post-2020, uncited search results, aggregators, and AGN-only papers. - One physical paper per source key; no duplicates. - IDs [REV09-P001], [REV09-P002], ... - Each row: [REV09-PNNN] Authors (year, journal) | title=exact title | DOI:value-or-none; arXiv:value-or-none; ADS:value | role=measurement|analytic_theory|hydrodynamic_simulation|semi_analytic_model|calibration | review_locator=section/topic | one-line boundary - If an identifier or review membership is uncertain, quarantine the row rather than making it usable. Composite identifier discipline - First author/year/title/DOI/arXiv/ADS must identify the same physical paper. - The paper must actually appear in the review bibliography. - Never splice neighboring reference identifiers. - Use none when an identifier genuinely does not exist. - Measurement rows must name redshift, galaxy selection, tracer, IMF/dust/metallicity calibration, and spatial/dynamical assumptions where relevant. 7. DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED - Quarantine uncertain, cross-wired, uncited, post-2020, AGN-centered, selection-collapsing, or overbroad items. - Format: UNCITED_NOT_USABLE | candidate or claim | supplied identifier/context | exclusion reason - Explicitly quarantine claims that all z~2 galaxies are disks or mergers, all clumps are long-lived, one line width proves rotation, low central dark matter means no halo, matching one scaling relation validates one unique model, or an AGN-only result is evidence for normal star-forming galaxies. - Quarantine post-2020/JWST/ML browsing results. 8. Review and source identity ledger - Repeat review as [REV09-R00] with DOI/arXiv/ADS. - Repeat every usable primary and supporting row with author/year/journal, DOI, arXiv, ADS, role, and boundary. - No load-bearing source may be absent from this ledger. Quality bar - Advisory source base, not polished wiki prose. - Prefer explicit sample, redshift, tracer, resolution, IMF, dust, and dynamical boundaries over broad claims. - Preserve observed versus inferred, calibrated versus predicted, and integrated versus resolved quantities. - Every source key in findings/debates/measurements/unknowns must resolve in the usable ledger. - End exactly: REVIEW_BASE_09_DR_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_ONLY
